tasks.title: Use schemas/ as canonical source for type defs in scaffolding
tasks.description:
- Removed inline GENERATORS.coconut_dts() from create-coconut-app
- Added resolve_schema() with remote-fetch (curl + PowerShell fallback), cache (~/.cache/coconut/schemas/), and bundled fallback
- Added copy_schema() helper
- Added --offline flag + COCONUT_OFFLINE env var
- Updated all three scaffold functions (bare, bare-ts, vite) to copy coconut.d.lua and scripts/coconut.d.ts
- Updated README directory tree
- Removed stale samples/coconut.d.lua
- Updated coconut.config.schema.json to match config.h

tasks.title: Decision: Option B — keep .d.ts/.d.lua hand-written, schemas/ as canonical
tasks.description: Chose Option B over schema-driven generator. schemas/coconut.d.ts and schemas/coconut.d.lua remain hand-written canonical files. Scaffolder will copy them with remote-fetch + cache + fallback. No schema-to-types generator.

tasks.title: Add CI for scaffold test and install script test
tasks.description:
- test-scaffold.yml: run on push/PR when scripts/create-coconut-app or schemas/* change, test all 3 templates, verify file structure, diff against canonical schemas
- build.yml: split release into package + release jobs; add test-install (Linux, shell+lua) and test-install-windows (PowerShell) jobs chained after package

tasks.title: Tier 2: Background thread infrastructure + bind_mt (vertical slice)
tasks.description: Implement the minimal vertical slice: split command registries, add bind_mt(), create background thread with own Lua state that loads .g.lua files, wire dispatch routing so commands run on the correct thread.
